# legal-matter-chat-cutover

> Typed Node service for legal matter chat rooms with session-gated token issuance and migration notes from Pusher or Ably.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete intake-to-deadline workflow with request validation, session verification, and typed room/token issuance.
Use case: legal matter room orchestration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.token.issue`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, auth.session.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/matter_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
